name: Eatransform Image Alt Manager
author: eatransform

sections.description:
Eatransform Image Alt Manager helps you improve your website’s accessibility and SEO by making it easy to find and manage images that are missing alt attributes.

Key Features:

  • Automatic Detection – Quickly scan your entire media library to find images without alt text
  • Visual Interface – See thumbnail previews of all images that need attention
  • Bulk Management – Edit multiple alt attributes from a single screen
  • Usage Tracking – See which posts and pages use each image
  • Filter Options – View all images, only used images, or only unused images
  • Simple & Fast – Clean, intuitive interface that gets the job done

Why Alt Attributes Matter:

  • Accessibility – Screen readers use alt text to describe images to visually impaired users
  • SEO – Search engines use alt text to understand image content
  • User Experience – Alt text displays when images fail to load
  • Legal Compliance – Many countries require accessible websites

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect or send any user data. All processing is done locally on your WordPress installation.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/eatransform-image-alt-manager directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to Media > Alt Manager to start managing your alt attributes
sections.faq:
How do I use this plugin?

After activation, go to Media > Alt Manager in your WordPress admin. You’ll see a list of all images that don’t have alt attributes. Simply enter the appropriate alt text for each image and click “Update Alt Attributes”.

Will this work with images already uploaded?

Yes! The plugin scans all existing images in your media library.

Does this work with page builders?

Yes, the plugin works with any WordPress site, regardless of theme or page builder.

What about images added through third-party plugins?

If the images are in your WordPress media library, they will be detected.
